Our Story

The details make the difference.

There's a bigger story behind the Froggy Mirrors name — a vision of transformation we've carried since day one. Today, that vision shows up in the tile and bath work we do: the finishes in your home should feel as considered as everything else in it.

From full shower and floor tile installations to complete bath remodels, every project is measured, fitted, and finished by hand — with an eye for the kind of detail that makes a space feel finished, not just functional.

When you're ready to stop settling for the bathroom you have and start building the one you actually want, we're ready to make the leap with you.

What We Do

Services

Design Consultation
